title: MONEYLOG 2.5.2
notes: Made sign-up and sign-in screens keyboard-safe on mobile so focused fields and actions remain reachable
Hardened Check now to perform a fresh network version check immediately and report connection failures honestly
Service worker update checks now refresh the registration before comparing the published version
Improved update reminder handling so available versions are surfaced without losing a later reminder
Added viewport-aware focus handling and small interaction reliability fixes
